entry.name: frame~
entry.digest: Output a list as an FFT frame or a signal vector
entry.description: The frame~ object is similar to the MSP sig~ object, but it provides a way to output lists inside a patcher loaded by the pfft~ object or to provide signal vector information outside of the pfft~ domain.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Any integer, floating point number, or list sent to theobject will cause a signal vector containing the value(s) to be sent out the object's outlet.

messages.name: fill
messages.digest: Specify a value for unset list values
messages.description: By default, theobject sets all unspecified frame values to 0. The word, followed by an integer or floating point value, will set all unspecified frame values to that amount.

messages.name: float
messages.description: A floating point number sent to theobject will cause a signal vector containing that value to be sent out the object's outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: An integer sent to theobject will cause a signal vector containing that value to be sent out the object's outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: A list of integers or floating point numbers sent to theobject will cause a signal vector containing those values to be sent out the object's outlet.

messages.name: mirror
messages.digest: Mirror all frame values around the Nyquist frequency
messages.description: By default, theobject sets all frame values above the Nyquist frequency to 0. When used in conjunction with aobject set to full spectrum mode, the messagewill enable mirroring all frame values.

inlets.digest: a list of floating point values

outlets.description: The list input to theobject is output as a signal vector. You can use theobject to convert the signal vector to a list of number values.
